description: Submit a real $0-due-online Las Vegas VIP table hold, free guestlist entry, complimentary strip-club house limo pickup, or corporate private-dining buyout request directly to the LasVegasTonight.com VIP Desk and receive an official LVT-XXXX-1234 confirmation code and out-the-door Nevada split sheet.

contactInput.description: Guest mobile phone number (for SMS confirmation) or email address (for itemized HTML split sheet)

girlsCount.description: Optional count of women in party (important for ratio/guestlist checks)

guestEmail.description: Optional email address if contactInput is a mobile number, to also email the itemized Nevada split sheet

guestName.description: Guest full name for the VIP podium or guestlist check-in

guysCount.description: Optional count of men in party (important for ratio/guestlist checks)

notes.description: Optional arrival window, preferred table section, or celebration notes

pickupHotel.description: Optional Strip/Downtown pickup hotel valet for complimentary gentlemen’s club house limo dispatch

requestType.description: One of: vip_table, free_guestlist, free_strip_club_limo, corporate_buyout

venueSlug.description: Target venue slug (e.g. xs-nightclub, omnia-nightclub, sapphire-gentlemens-club, delilah-wynn)

name: submit_vip_table_or_guestlist_hold
